title: KCAdmissionObservation/v1 (CANDIDATE)
description: CANDIDATE closed record of ONE observed native resolver outcome (KCLIVE-01, KC-Brain decision comment 6710410432 on Arcanada-one/arcanada-shared). It is separate from BookPackage/2, PackageTreeVerification/v1, PrivateExactReadbackReceipt/v1 and any runtime authority receipt. status=observed means a persisted NATIVE record was read and its exact bytes were hashed (sha256-exact-bytes of the same bytes that were parsed); status=unavailable means no durable verifiable source record exists and carries a typed reason, never a synthesized success. SCHEMA VALIDITY NEVER MEANS ADMISSION READY: claims_scope is fixed to resolver-outcome-observation-only and issuer_authority, source_admission, runtime_authorization, consumer_delivery and publication are all NOT_MEASURED; there is no authorized/admitted/publishable or other success boolean. A matching native_source.sha256 shows only that the supplied bytes were the bytes parsed; it does not establish the origin of the expected hash, an issuer, a source revision or admission. Field names marked PROVISIONAL are implementer-chosen pending KC-Brain. Cross-field rules are in tools/check_kc_admission_observation.py; hosted structural checks, native integration, consumer readback and issuer authority are separate proof stages. Task descriptions and private payloads never appear here.

claims_scope.description: Fixed. This record observes a resolver outcome and nothing more.

claims.description: Every claim beyond the observation is NOT_MEASURED in v1. Absent is not the same as NOT_MEASURED: all five keys are required.

task_id.description: The intake task id of the native record. No task description.

native_source.description: PROVISIONAL names. Where the native source persisted the decision: system, an immutable record id/ref, the actual recorded-at if the record has one, and the sha256 of the exact record bytes that were parsed.

system.description: Source system label. synthetic-fixture marks a fixture, never a native observation.

record_id.description: Immutable id or ref of the native record. Not a file path.

recorded_at.description: Present only if the native record carries a time; never invented.

source_schema.description: Only if the native record genuinely carries a schema/version.

work_item_binding.description: PROVISIONAL. Source proof of the native Muneral write that created work_item_id: the immutable Muneral record id and the sha256 of the exact record bytes read. A resolver contract alone is not a work item.

verdict.description: The measured resolver verdict as the native record states it, never inferred from an HTTP status and never paired with the outcome by this schema.

obligation.description: PROVISIONAL, mirrors Argana IntakeOutcome.obligations items (src/argana/intake.py, key kind).

unavailable.description: No durable verifiable native record: a typed reason and nothing positive.

reason.description: PROVISIONAL enum. outcome_not_persisted: the outcome exists only in a transient response.

observed_contract.description: Observed native outcome contract. contract_digest only after the canonical halves recompute to it (checked by the tool, not by this schema).

message_id.description: PROVISIONAL. Optional message/evidence identity; if present it must equal native_source.record_id.

contract_digest.description: Mirrors the native digest form sha256:<64 hex>.

obligations.description: Existing resolver obligations are carried, never dropped; a K verdict needs at least one.

observed_underdetermined.description: Observed native outcome underdetermined: missing requirements, never a work item or digest.

missing.description: PROVISIONAL. Mirrors Argana IntakeOutcome.missing (one object per missing artifact; native example key capability_token).

observed_refusal.description: Observed native outcome refusal with a typed code.

refusal_code.description: Mirrors the native code form, e.g. CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED. Open typed string: native codes are not a closed list.
